payload.title: A Love Good for Nothing
payload.subTitle: Pointless one night turns into true love
payload.description: Dohye, a 39-year-old unmarried woman, finally decides to accept the heart of a guy who's had a crush on her for six years, but ends up getting an unexpected invitation to his wedding with another woman. In frustration, she spends a drunken one night with a nerd who moved in next door, but shockingly enough, the nerd turns out to be her new boss later.
payload.logLine: A conservative man and a woman spend a drunken night by mistake. Should they get married? Or just let it go?
payload.casting:
Lee Dong-geon, Park Ha-seon
Lee Ju-an, Yu Su-rim
